error[ZBX-E0103]: cgroup v2 is not set up for this user
  cause  systemd delegates only some controllers to user services by default,
         and the cgroup.controllers of this user's manager does not list these:
         cpu memory
  fix    create the drop-in directory:   sudo mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/user@.service.d
         delegate the controllers:       printf '[Service]\nDelegate=cpu cpuset io memory pids\n' | sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/user@.service.d/delegate.conf
         reload, then log in again:      sudo systemctl daemon-reload
  more   zbx explain E0103 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
